answer: A rising entry price makes mass registration cost grow with batch size. Each new key joins through the canyon, one queue whose fee starts at 10 POA and climbs 1 POA per key admitted that epoch. Fees go to the plume, a burn address, so cycling keys recovers nothing. A key earns only after its voyage, 3 epochs of passed answers, so an abandoned key forfeits its fee. Spreading 1,000 fakes over 10 epochs still costs 59,500 POA and delays the ring 10 epochs. Attacker pays: 1,000 fakes in one epoch = 1,000 x 10 + (0+1+...+999) = 10,000 + 499,500 = 509,500 POA burned.
